title: Wiki raw source frontmatter
description: A raw copy under wiki/raw/ as LLM-Wiki-V2 writes it (OKF type Source), plus the fields the capture step adds so the temporal lint and the copyright policy can run.

resource.description: Where the original lives: an absolute URL for public material

published_at.description: Extension: publication date of the original; required so no note can cite something newer than its claims

origin_kind.description: Extension: own material may be kept in full; third-party material is kept as a note or short excerpt only

license_note.description: Extension: what may be reproduced from this source in a public repository
